$comment: ENV-08: what the cell (apps/runtime-cell/internal/recipe), the worker (libs/runtime/protocol/recipe.ts, held to the cell's verdict) and Runo's parseRecipe say about each recipe. A path is from the repository root. A verdict is accept, or refuse: <text the error contains>. why says what a difference between the two is for. healthTimeoutSeconds, when set, is the wait an accepted recipe resolves to in the cell and the worker (health_timeout, capped at 900 s). healthTimeoutDefault, when true, says the recipe sets no wait of its own (health_timeout: 0 is not set): the cell waits its default and the worker leaves the wait out. unapplied lists the keys an accepted recipe sets that no cell acts on yet (recipe.Unapplied, the worker's recipe.unapplied); absent means none.

libs/runtime/protocol/fixtures/recipes/k.why: a cell boots the checkout's default compose file without being told; Runo wants the services named

libs/runtime/protocol/fixtures/recipes/r.why: a cell boots a compose project only; Runo also runs images and host commands on its VM

.kodus/workspace.yaml.why: Kodus's own dev recipe copies the developer's .env: right on their VM, never on a cell (ADR-008)

.kodus/workspace.preview.yaml.why: the PR preview copies .env from CI secrets: a Runo VM holds them, a cell never does

libs/runtime/protocol/fixtures/recipes/r.why: env files never go to a cell's machine; on a developer's own VM they may
a cell never takes a secret from the recipe; Runo does not read values
the cell decides how the program starts; on a developer's VM the developer does
a cell has only the checkout; a developer's machine has their other repositories
a cell refuses a key it does not know, so a typo never boots quietly; Runo ignores it
both refuse a negative wait; only the wording differs
